Risk Description: Transactional email vendor handles 100% of OTP and password-reset emails. Outage breaks signup and account recovery flows.
Planned Controls: Onboard secondary email vendor; implement DNS-based failover; degraded-mode flow allowing in-app OTP fallback

Risk Description: Public login endpoint has no rate-limiting or bot protection. Account takeover risk for users who reuse passwords.
Vulnerability: No rate-limit; no CAPTCHA; MFA optional not enforced
Existing Controls: Password complexity policy; account-lockout after 10 attempts
Planned Controls: Deploy WAF rate-limit; integrate bot-detection; enforce MFA for all users by Q3 2026

Risk Title: GDPR DSR backlog and missed deadline
Risk Description: No defined DSR workflow. Manual handling means 30-day clock can be missed; no identity verification step documented.
Vulnerability: No DSR tooling; no published process
Planned Controls: Implement DSR intake form; document workflow; verify identity per Art. 12(6); train support team

Risk Title: Pen-test critical findings unremediated past auditor deadline
Risk Description: 4 Critical findings from external pen-test; 30 days to remediate; product roadmap has no slack.
Planned Controls: Validate findings (rule out FPs); deploy WAF rules as compensating controls; assign owners; retest in 45 days
Linked ISO 27001 Annex A Control: A.8.29 Security testing in development and acceptance
Notes: See Scenario 10. Compensating-controls memo required for findings not closed in 30 days.

Risk Description: DR backups taken nightly; never restored end-to-end. Unknown whether RTO/RPO targets are achievable.
Vulnerability: No documented restore test; no RTO/RPO validation

Planned Controls: Quarterly restore test; document RTO/RPO actuals; tabletop exercise
